calibration_reason: The first source-only eligibility audit exposed two evaluator/source-realization defects before Candidate-v13 was ever run externally: a generic domain classifier over-assigned temporal words such as when/date/time to D3, and PerLTQA non-profile evidence IDs did not mechanically resolve. This v2 removes those defects while preserving the preregistered domains, structural-family definitions, stage sizes, thresholds, source-independence requirement, source-native/deterministic gold requirement, and one-shot rules.

personamem-v2.gold_memory_ids: one deterministic ID for the source row's verbatim related_conversation_snippet
personamem-v2.subject: persona_id evaluator-only subject identity
personamem-v2.relation: verbatim topic_preference when nonempty, otherwise topic_query, otherwise preference
personamem-v2.contradiction: prev_pref and current preference are both nonempty and normalized unequal
personamem-v2.domain_input: source-native topic_preference + topic_query only; user_query and memory text do not influence domain classification

longmemeval-cleaned.memories: each source haystack session concatenated in original message order with source role labels retained; session ID remains runtime memory ID and source date is timestamp
longmemeval-cleaned.gold_memory_ids: verbatim answer_session_ids; every ID must exist in haystack_session_ids
longmemeval-cleaned.subject: question_id/history identity evaluator metadata
longmemeval-cleaned.domain_input: verbatim question + gold session text under strict domain vocabulary; no generic when/date/time tokens

locomo.memories: individual source conversation turns, runtime ID = <sample_id>::<dia_id>, text = verbatim speaker + ': ' + text, timestamp = source session date_time
locomo.gold_memory_ids: every nonempty source QA evidence dia_id, prefixed by sample_id; all evidence IDs must exact-resolve inside the same sample
locomo.answerability_eligibility: question nonempty, answer nonempty, evidence nonempty, and every evidence ID exact-resolves; unresolved/no-evidence/missing-answer QA are excluded rather than repaired
locomo.subject: evaluator-only set of speaker identities on gold evidence turns
locomo.relation: source QA category retained as evaluator metadata but not used as a semantic domain label
locomo.domain_input: verbatim question + exact gold evidence turn text under strict domain vocabulary; no generic when/date/time tokens

sgd-carryover.gold_memory: verbatim nearest earlier USER turn in same dialogue/service that explicitly span-annotates the carried slot and whose source-native state.slot_values contains the same normalized value
sgd-carryover.runtime_memory_text: verbatim prior/current USER utterance only; service, slot, state and family labels remain evaluator-only and are never appended to memory text
sgd-carryover.subject: dialogue-local user/evaluator identity
sgd-carryover.relation: source-native service + carried slot evaluator metadata
sgd-carryover.domain: source-native service-prefix map: Calendar/Events -> D3; Banks/Media/Messaging/Movies/Music/Payment/Services -> D4; Buses/Flights/Hotels/RentalCars/Ridesharing/Trains/Travel -> D5
structural_native: N5 when current query has a generic coreference token
N4 when current USER turn carries two or more distinct relations
forbidden: put service/slot/state metadata into runtime text
semantic text matching to choose gold

domain_classifier.rule: Each base item has exactly one evaluator-only D1-D8 domain. SGD uses source-native service mapping. PersonaMem uses topic metadata only. LoCoMo and LongMemEval use strict phrase/token matching over query + exact gold evidence. Generic temporal interrogatives (when/date/time/today/tomorrow/day names) are explicitly forbidden as domain evidence.

fallbacks.personamem-v2: D1 because the source row is explicitly a preference-memory record
fallbacks.longmemeval-cleaned: D8 because the source record is a personal interaction/history when no stricter domain noun is present
fallbacks.locomo: D8 because the source record is a personal conversational event/history when no stricter domain noun is present

structural_family_eligibility.N1: answerable non-SGD base case with exactly one gold memory, 3-30 natural query tokens, and no N2/N5/N6/N7/N8/N11 natural stress flag
structural_family_eligibility.N2: natural query has >=18 tokens OR >=2 comma/semicolon/parenthetical boundaries OR contains a fixed generic discourse marker
structural_family_eligibility.N3: a deterministic distractor from a different evaluator subject/history exists; runtime query is unchanged
structural_family_eligibility.N4: SGD current turn carries >=2 relations OR a deterministic same-subject different-relation distractor exists
structural_family_eligibility.N5: SGD or other natural query contains a fixed generic pronoun/demonstrative/coreference token while explicit evaluator subject is absent from the query
structural_family_eligibility.N6: PersonaMem source-native update/prev_pref OR LongMemEval question_type in {knowledge-update, temporal-reasoning}
structural_family_eligibility.N7: PersonaMem prev_pref and current preference are both nonempty and normalized unequal
structural_family_eligibility.N8: natural query or exact gold memory contains a fixed modality/uncertainty token: may, might, maybe, perhaps, possibly, probably, plan, planned, planning, hope, expect, intend, tentative, could, would, should
structural_family_eligibility.N9: a deterministic non-gold distractor exists whose normalized query-token overlap is strictly greater than the best gold-memory overlap; gold/query text are not rewritten
structural_family_eligibility.N10: any valid base case; every gold memory is withheld by the preregistered no-evidence transform
structural_family_eligibility.N11: SGD source-native carry-over relation OR a non-SGD natural query <=12 tokens with an elliptical signal; formal allocation prefers SGD carry-over cases
structural_family_eligibility.N12: a deterministic non-gold memory exists with the same evaluator subject/history identity and relation metadata as the gold case

memory_composition.default: all gold memories plus deterministic source-disjoint eligible distractors up to 20 total runtime memories
memory_composition.N3: include at least one different-subject/history distractor
memory_composition.N4: include at least one same-subject different-relation distractor when family eligibility comes from a constructed competition rather than native SGD multi-relation
memory_composition.N6: retain source-native stale/current evidence when source supplies both states
memory_composition.N12: include at least one same-subject same-relation non-gold distractor
